answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can earn, with peer grading on each job. A cheater loses its stake and its reputation, so spinning up a hundred fake agents means funding a hundred deposits that all get slashed, and the cost ripples through the whole attack. Like a saffron trader who can only sell one verified batch at a time, each agent can only vouch for work it truly did, and every attestation is signed with a cipher key bound to its stake, so cheap clones cannot borrow the original trust.
